en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own trip and test a Mexico City working month against your budget cap
en.runTitle: São Paulo to Mexico City: a Brazilian remote-working couple, one month in March 2027, BRL 22,000

fields.label: Travel dates and GRU flight totals
Each passport and qualifying visa or residence documents
Actual duties, employer approval and entry-classification advice
fields.value: Both remote software workers paid in BRL, working Brazil hours

fields.label: All-in apartment offers, deposit and cancellation terms
fields.placeholder: e.g. furnished 1-bedroom in Roma, MXN 30,000 a month, one month’s deposit, free cancellation up to 14 days before

fields.label: Two-person internet and workstation needs
fields.value: Reliable internet and a dedicated desk in the apartment

fields.label: Payment-method effective FX
fields.placeholder: e.g. card at BRL 0.29 per MXN after fees

en.template: Help us test a Mexico City working month using {travel}, {passports}, {duties}, {apartment}, {workspace} and {fx}. Keep the BRL 22,000 cap, show the weaker-real and higher-rent cases, and tell us what must change before we commit. Ask before contacting anyone, applying, booking or sharing personal documents.

phases.title: Read the official entry rules and gather flight, rent, phone and transport prices
phases.note: Entry rules, apartment examples, flights, connectivity and safety guidance
phases.judgment: It would not call remote work cleared. Mexico’s visitor guidance recognises some foreign-paid business activities, but the explicit permission to work for a foreign salary it found belongs to temporary residence, not the electronic visa, so the guide leaves that question open.

phases.title: Write the guide with a month budget in pesos and reais, and a claim-by-claim source list
phases.note: Neighbourhood comparison, entry checklist, budget table, weaker-real and higher-rent cases
phases.judgment: The answer is “not yet”. The conditional budget fits at BRL 21,136.36, but swapping in the real Roma apartment example it found pushes the total to BRL 22,984.85, over the BRL 22,000 cap.

phases.title: Independent check of every number, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The independent colleague confirmed the arithmetic, then said plainly what that does not prove: a passing sum is not trip readiness. It also noted the airline example could not be reproduced independently, so that evidence stays limited.

workers: Read Mexican and Brazilian government pages on entry for Brazilians, including the electronic visa, length of stay and remote-work guidance
Gathered public prices for flights from São Paulo, the BRL/MXN rate, mobile data and transport, plus guidance on water, altitude and earthquakes
Found dated one-month furnished apartment examples in Roma, Condesa and other neighbourhoods, and read their terms
Recomputed every money figure on its own and checked the claims against the source list
